title: Mango Lassi with Cardamom and Pistachio
summary: Ripe mango, whole-milk yoghurt, milk, honey, lime juice, salt and cardamom are blended until silky and served topped with pistachios.

ingredients.item: ripe mango flesh, fresh or frozen, chopped
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Put the mango, yoghurt, milk, honey, lime juice, salt and cardamom in the blender. Blend on low for 10 seconds, then on high for about 1 minute until completely smooth, scraping down the sides once.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Taste, and add more honey if the mango was tart. If too thick to pour, add cold water 1-2 tbsp at a time. For an extra-silky lassi, push it through a sieve, which helps with stringy mangoes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour into glasses, over ice if you used fresh rather than frozen mango, and scatter with the pistachios.

tips: Alphonso or Kesar mangoes give the deepest colour and flavour; good tinned Alphonso pulp also works (reduce the honey).
Frozen mango makes the lassi cold and thick without ice.
Use thick, full-fat yoghurt; low-fat yoghurt makes it thin and sharp.
Starting the blender on low stops the frozen mango from jamming.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 1 day; stir before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
